name: ta7ady-elgeel
description: Ta7ady ElGeel Electron + React game-show source (V34 gameplay-clarity baseline).

scripts.dev: node scripts/generate-runtime-game-config.mjs && node scripts/verify-v2-minigame-baseline.mjs && node scripts/verify-v2-minigame-grid.mjs && node scripts/verify-v2-scoring-policy.mjs && node scripts/verify-landing-experience.mjs && concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "npm run build:electron && wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: npm run verify:integrity && npm run verify:experience-v32 && npm run verify:assets && npm run verify:css && npm run typecheck && vite build && npm run build:electron
scripts.build:electron: node scripts/generate-runtime-game-config.mjs && node scripts/verify-v2-minigame-baseline.mjs && node scripts/verify-v2-minigame-grid.mjs && node scripts/verify-v2-scoring-policy.mjs && node scripts/verify-landing-experience.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json
scripts.test: npm run verify:integrity && npm run verify:localization-contract && npm run verify:assets && npm run verify:css && node scripts/generate-runtime-game-config.mjs && node scripts/verify-v2-minigame-baseline.mjs && node scripts/verify-v2-minigame-grid.mjs && node scripts/verify-v2-scoring-policy.mjs && node scripts/verify-landing-experience.mjs && npm run verify:experience-v32 && vitest run
scripts.typecheck: npm run verify:localization-contract && node scripts/generate-runtime-game-config.mjs && node scripts/verify-v2-minigame-baseline.mjs && node scripts/verify-v2-minigame-grid.mjs && node scripts/verify-v2-scoring-policy.mjs && node scripts/verify-landing-experience.mjs && tsc --noEmit
scripts.lint: npm run verify:integrity && npm run typecheck && eslint "scripts/**/*.{mjs,cjs}" eslint.config.js
scripts.verify:gameplay-config: node scripts/generate-runtime-game-config.mjs && node scripts/verify-v2-minigame-baseline.mjs && node scripts/verify-v2-minigame-grid.mjs && node scripts/verify-v2-scoring-policy.mjs && node scripts/verify-landing-experience.mjs && node scripts/verify-v2-final-flow-lock.mjs
scripts.verify:cleanup: npm run verify:integrity && npm run verify:css && npm run verify:assets && npm run verify:desktop-ux && node scripts/verify-premium-stage-mode.mjs && node scripts/verify-v2-mode-picker-target-layout.mjs && npm run verify:premium-experience
scripts.verify:integrity: node scripts/verify-source-integrity.mjs && node scripts/verify-true-fake-bank.mjs && node scripts/verify-v33-reveal-consistency.mjs
